name: vgi
description: Query APIs, models, and services like ordinary tables — no code, just SQL. VGI (Vector Gateway Interface) exposes your own Python, TypeScript, Go, or Rust code as DuckDB catalogs, tables, and functions, with no native extension to compile. Your code stays in its own runtime; SQL users discover, query, and join it like any other table.

cta.title: Turn APIs, models, and code into SQL
cta.description: Attach a hosted worker as a catalog and DuckDB queries it like any other database — discover its schema, query its tables, and join it with your local data.
